items.item_text: Basic Life Support - BLS, upon hire
Advanced Cardiac Life Support - ACLS, upon hire
3-5 years circulating experience in a Perioperative setting in multiple service-lines, upon hire
Provides comprehensive nursing care through accurate patient assessment, care planning, implementation, evaluation, pain management, and recognition of changes in patient condition.

Demonstrates proficiency in essential clinical skills, including IV and central line management, blood specimen collection, urinary and NG catheter care, tracheostomy care, medication administration, point-of-care testing, and post-operative pain management.

Promotes patient safety and quality care by adhering to infection prevention, standard precautions, fall and injury prevention, patient identification, informed consent, advance directives, confidentiality, and organizational policies.
Advocates for patients and families by providing individualized education, emotional support, culturally responsive care, and clear communication while supporting informed healthcare decisions.

Collaborates effectively with physicians and interdisciplinary teams through SBAR handoffs, accurate documentation, appropriate delegation and supervision, continuity-of-care reporting, emergency preparedness, and ongoing professional development.
Registered Nurse: CA RN, upon hire
